verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago documents broad programmatic coverage of merchant operations. Its CLI runs payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores and reports from a single token without a browser or visual client. It also offers Checkout API, POS machine APIs, and an MCP server for test users and webhook configuration. However, nothing documents parity with the UI: payment links are described as generated in the app or website, and consumer features such as transfers, yields and account opening show no API path. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API evidence for payment-link creation and the consumer account features (transfers, investments), and independent hands-on confirmation that UI-only actions are absent.
